# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Evidence

List the issue, ADR, tests, docs, or command output that supports this change.

## Required Checks

- [ ] Relevant tests pass locally.
- [ ] CI is expected to pass.
- [ ] Documentation updated or explicitly not needed.
- [ ] ADR reviewed or explicitly not needed.
- [ ] Security review completed.
- [ ] Regression review completed.
- [ ] Bug sweep completed or explicitly not needed.
- [ ] Vulnerability sweep completed or explicitly not needed.
- [ ] Release notes impact reviewed.

## Risk

Describe security, production, compatibility, or user-experience risks.

## Follow-up Issues

List follow-up issues or write `None`.
